name: aippocampus
description: Source-backed continuity memory for Codex agents across threads, projects, devices, and life-wide conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Recover source-backed conversation memory without pretending the model has innate memory.
interface.longDescription: AIppocampus is the friendly install wrapper for the skill and local MCP tools that provide source-backed continuity across agent threads. It helps agents reopen local source trails without pretending the base model has innate memory. Hook installers and optional DeepSeek-compatible routes are included, but hooks and external-model paths require explicit user action after reviewing the privacy boundary.
